about_the_game:
Brave meowgician! Are you ready to embark on a wondrous journey through a different dimension?

In "The Lost Meowgician," you play as a magical cat. During the final exam at the Magic Academy, you and your friend met with an accident and were pulled into a dimensional rift. To find your companion and a way back home, you must venture deep into an unknown world, using your magical wisdom to grow stronger with every challenge.

When Match-3 Meets Tower Defense

The Lost Meowgician fuses match-3 and tower defense on a single battlefield. Every match you make isn't just for points—it's to "load" your magical cannons!

  • Left-Side - The Strategy Zone: Here, you'll strategize on the match-3 board. Swap tiles to make matches of 3, 4, or even 5 to load powerful spells into your action queue.

  • Right-Side - The Tower Defense Zone: Once you're done matching, the spells in your queue will automatically fire in sequence, striking down approaching enemies on the path.

Craft Your Own "Magic Combos"

The core fun of the game lies in deep strategic build-crafting. You aren't just playing a game; you're creating your own unique formula for victory.

  • Versatile Spells, Creative Synergies: The game offers spells with diverse effects, each with different upgrade paths. Will you aim for single-target takedowns or field-clearing AoEs? Will you build a control-focused or summon-based strategy? The choice is all yours.

  • Magical Treasures, Game-Changing Effects: A vast collection of treasures with powerful effects provides endless possibilities for your build. A single key treasure can often transform your entire playstyle.

Every Adventure is a Fresh Start

Thanks to its Roguelite mechanics, every adventure feels new.

  • Tower-Climbing Progression: Explore randomized maps composed of combat, event, and shop rooms. Carefully plan your route to challenge powerful elites and a final boss at the end of each floor.

  • Map Layout System: This isn't a journey you just passively accept! Before tackling a new floor, you can spend resources to personally arrange the order of the rooms on the map. Will you rush to the shop first to power up, or bravely challenge more elites for greater rewards? Your strategy begins before you even enter the map.

  • Meta-Progression, Unlock the Future: Every effort in your adventures pays off. Permanently unlock new spells, treasures, and events to constantly enrich the game's content pool, giving you more options and a stronger start in future runs!

Game Features:

  • Innovative Fusion Gameplay: Perfectly combines the satisfying chain reactions of match-3 with the strategic depth of tower defense.

  • Deep Strategic Build-Crafting: A huge variety of spells and treasures to create unique combat builds.

  • High Replayability Roguelite: Randomized maps, enemies, and rewards make every challenge unpredictable.

  • Unique Map Layout System: Before you climb, you design the map, putting you in control.

  • Charming Hand-Drawn Style: A cute cat protagonist and a relaxing, wholesome doodle art style to accompany you through every thrilling battle.

Add "The Lost Meowgician" to your wishlist now and get ready for a strategic adventure you can't put down!

short_description: The Lost Meowgician blends match-3, tower defense, and roguelite strategy. Match tiles to cast spells against waves of enemies. Combine spells and treasures to create unique builds and unleash satisfying combos in a charming, hand-drawn world.
